description: Get the review summary (score label, positive/negative counts, %) and a few reviews for a game by appid — by default the most helpful ones posted in the last 30 days; set order for the newest or most recently edited instead, or within_days to widen/narrow the helpful window. Review text over 600 characters is truncated. An unknown appid comes back as summary 'No user reviews' with zero counts rather than an error — Steam answers success for any id — so that result means either no such appid or a game nobody has reviewed yet; confirm the appid with get_game if that distinction matters. For long-term trend instead of a snapshot, use get_review_histogram. Get the appid from search_games. No API key required.

appid.description: Steam application id (appid). Get it from search_games.

order.description: helpful (default) = most voted-helpful within within_days; recent = newest first; updated = most recently edited first. The summary counts are the same in every order.

review_language.description: Filter reviews by language. Use Steam's full language name — english, russian, schinese — NOT an ISO code like en/ru/zh: Steam answers an unrecognized value with zero reviews rather than an error, so a 9M-review game reads as having none. Default 'all'. Setting this ALSO rescopes the summary counts (total_reviews / positive / negative / %) to that language — they are no longer the game's global totals. Leave it at 'all' when you want those.

type.description: Only positive or negative reviews. Default 'all'. Steam only computes the summary (score label, totals, %) for 'all' — filtering to positive/negative nulls those fields out, leaving only the review excerpts.

within_days.description: order='helpful' only: how many past days the helpful ranking covers (1-365). Default 30 (Steam's own); 365 is Steam's ceiling — larger windows return the same reviews (verified live), so there is no all-time ranking.

name: get_game_reviews
title: Get game reviews
